item.title: Brick facade breathes without fans by using the sun-warmed cavity behind it
item.description: An office building in a hot climate pulls fresh air through a perforated brick screen. Sun heats the cavity, warm air rises and exits at the top, and cool air is drawn in at the bottom. There are no moving parts, but the effect is weak on calm cloudy days.

item.title: Factory replaces its central scheduler with machines that bid for jobs
item.description: Instead of planning the whole production day in advance, each machine in the plant announces when it is free and bids for the next job. The plant loses a globally optimal plan but recovers from breakdowns within minutes.

item.title: Timber bridge uses its own weight to lock its joints
item.description: A reciprocal frame bridge is made of short beams that each rest on the next. No nails or glue are needed: gravity tightens every joint, so the bridge gets stiffer under load. Removing a single beam, however, collapses the span.
